item.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

media:content.media:description: The storm could bring life-threatening catastrophic flooding and mudslides, especially in areas with steep terrain across the eastern and southern portions of the islands.

media:content.media:text: A color satellite image of a hurricane swirling in the Pacific Ocean.
media:content.media:description: Nolo is then forecast to make a turn to the west on Saturday as it strengthens into a major hurricane.
